blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements for Risk360 Advanced.
The Risk360 service supports the following frameworks:
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

A weekly and on-demand Operating Entity Risk Report is added to the Reports page to conduct portfolio risk assessment by quantifying risk at the operating entity level. You can also change the entity source for the report.
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Risk Reports and Managing Operating Entity Risk Report Settings.
The following factors under the Data Loss category are available in the Risk360 Admin Portal that quantifies risk for your Data Loss Prevention (DLP) traffic:

blocks.item: Block Mode Policy with Organizational Unit Exceptions
Usage of Custom Engine in Policy
DLP Policies for Critical File Types
Usage of Custom Engine in Policies
Usage of Custom Engine in Policies
Block Mode Policies with Organizational Unit Exceptions
Usage of Custom Engine in Policies
Usage of Index Tool Virtual Machines for EDM and IDM

blocks.text: With the preceding factor additions, the existing Are DLP Policies Configured factor is no longer available.
To learn more, see About Factors.
You can download the Cyber Insurance Addendum Report, a comprehensive quarterly and on-demand report of your zero trust security posture.
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Risk Reports.

blocks.heading: Factor for Posture Profiles Not Used in Access Policies

blocks.text: The factor Posture Profiles Not Used in Access Policies under the Lateral Propagation category is available to quantify risk for access policies without a device posture profile.
See image.
To learn more, see About Factors.
The Risk360 service supports the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an information security management system (ISMS) for your organization.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk with ISO 27001.

blocks.heading: Support for Custom Peer Score Settings

blocks.text: You can add custom strategies for peer score calculations and switch between them to view peer scores calculated based on different attributes such as industry vertical, geographical region, and revenue range.
See image.
When a new peer score strategy is enabled, the Risk Score Trend graph indicates it with the Event indicator and the score changes for that date.
See image.
To learn more, see Managing Peer Score Settings and About Dashboard.

The Risk360 service supports the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publication (SP) 800-53 that provides guidance on selecting, implementing, and assessing security and privacy controls for federal information systems and organizations. This publication helps organizations comply with the Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) and other regulations.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk with NIST SP 800-53.

blocks.heading: Support for Gen AI Risk Factors

blocks.text: The Risk360 service supports three generative AI factors under the Data Loss category to quantify your organization's risk for user data privacy, sensitive data loss, and usage risk when interacting with generative AI apps.
See image.
To learn more, see About Factors.

You can download the Risk Management Mitigation Strategy Report that outlines the mitigation strategy for important risk factors impacting your organization's cyber risk. This report is autogenerated once a week.
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Risk Reports.

To learn more, see About Factors.

You can edit the Zscaler-computed breach probability to the values of your choice using the Simulate toggle on the Monte Carlo Simulation page (Financial Risk > Monte Carlo Simulation). The organization's financial exposure is reevaluated based on new values. You can restore the Zscaler-computed probability at a later time if required.
See image.
To learn more, see Quantifying Loss With Monte Carlo Simulation.
The following enhancements are available for the financial risk architecture in the Risk360 Admin Portal:

blocks.item: You can manage various settings for your organization's financial risk calculation from the Financial Risk Settings section on the Account page.

The existing financial risk exposure calculation method has been updated. Therefore, the Loss Curve chart on the Financial Risk page might show a spike or drop in the graph from the date the calculation method is updated.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Managing Financial Risk Settings and About Financial Risk.
